Cost: 1,200eb (Very Expensive)

Hydrosubsidium, iconic designer of innovative aquatic tech, have gone back to basics. This neoprene bodysuit is comfortable, durable, and its rebreather can filter out 98.9% of toxic chemicals.

(Notice: Warranty only good for dives of up to 25 feet. Gold-tier subscription owners are advised to consult a doctor before pursuing underwater activities near or within North America)

SP7 Armor with built-in Flashlight and Radio Communicator. This armor isn’t bought in two pieces and must always be worn on the user’s body and head location. When repaired, both pieces are repaired at the same time. Comes with an oxygen tank (50eb [Costly] per extra) connected to the sealed helmet, which contains 30 minutes of air, before it must be refilled from the ambient atmosphere, which takes 1 hour. Attached flippers negate movement penalties when swimming.

Covers: Body and Head (one piece)
SP: 7
Armor Penalty: none

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Armor & Fashion > Armor Catalog).
